issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation attributes the statement 'Ngươi là Con ta, ngày nay ta đã sinh ngươi' (You are my Son, today I have begotten you) to God ('Đức Chúa Trời'), whereas the Greek text 'τινι γαρ ειπεν ποτε των αγγελων υιος μου' implies a question about whether Jesus (the Son) ever said to an angel: 'My son...'. The Vietnamese structure makes it sound like God is speaking to an angel, rather than Jesus speaking to an angel.
